heading.en: First World War and the inter-war years

body.zh-Hant: 布朗寧在第一次世界大戰中隨擲彈兵衛隊服役，獲頒傑出服務勳章與戰爭十字勳章。他於1920年晉升上尉、1928年晉升少校，並曾任桑德赫斯特皇家軍事學院首任副官；1928年聖莫里茨冬季奧運會，他是英國雪橇隊成員。1935年晉升中校，同年出任擲彈兵衛隊第2營營長。
body.en: Browning began his military career in the First World War with the Grenadier Guards and won the Distinguished Service Order and the Croix de Guerre. He was promoted Captain in 1920 and Major in 1928, and served as the first Adjutant at the Royal Military College, Sandhurst. At the 1928 Winter Olympics in St. Moritz he was a member of the British bobsleigh team. Promoted Lieutenant-Colonel in 1935, he became commanding officer of the 2nd Battalion, Grenadier Guards that year.

heading.zh-Hant: 空降部隊的創建與第1空降師
heading.en: Raising British airborne forces and the 1st Airborne Division

body.zh-Hant: 1940年他受命指揮第24近衛旅；1941年10月，邱吉爾任命他為第1空降師師長並晉升少將。1943年4月他離開該師，改任艾森豪的空降顧問，督導西西里空降突擊的規劃，並於同年5月6日卸下師長職務；同年12月晉升中將。
body.en: In 1940 he was given command of the 24th Guards Brigade, and in October 1941 Churchill appointed him commander of the 1st Airborne Division with promotion to Major-General. In April 1943 he left the division to become Airborne Advisor to Eisenhower, overseeing the planning of the airborne assault on Sicily, and relinquished command of the division on 6 May 1943; he was promoted Lieutenant General in December of that year.

heading.zh-Hant: 第1空降軍與市場花園行動
heading.en: 1st Airborne Corps and Operation Market Garden

body.zh-Hant: 1944年4月16日，布朗寧接任第1空降軍軍長；該軍同年8月成為第1盟軍空降集團軍的一部分，他兼任該集團軍副司令。第1空降軍指揮了市場花園行動（阿納姆戰役）中投入的空降部隊，布朗寧帶著戰術指揮部降落在奈梅亨附近，卻因通訊故障與部隊分散而難以指揮。
body.en: On 16 April 1944 Browning became commander of the 1st Airborne Corps, which that August became part of the First Allied Airborne Army, of which he was also Deputy Commander. The corps commanded the airborne forces committed in Operation Market Garden; Browning landed with a tactical headquarters near Nijmegen but found it difficult to command because of communications failures and the separation of his units.

body.zh-Hant: 蒙哥馬利並未將市場花園行動的失敗歸咎於布朗寧，但他此後沒有再獲晉升。他其後出任蒙巴頓東南亞盟軍司令部的參謀長，1946至1948年任陸軍部軍務秘書。
body.en: Montgomery attached no blame to Browning for the failure of Market Garden, but he received no further promotion. He subsequently became Chief of Staff to Lord Mountbatten and was Military Secretary of the War Office in 1946-1948.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰時早期的指揮與規劃任務
heading.en: Early wartime commands and planning tasks

body.zh-Hant: 摩根1940年在法國擔任第1裝甲師下一個戰鬥群的指揮官。1942年5月他受命指揮第1軍區，同年10月出任第1軍軍長並歸艾森豪指揮。他被交付準備在西地中海進行輔助登陸，之後奉命規劃入侵薩丁尼亞，再奉命規劃入侵西西里。
body.en: In 1940 Morgan served in France commanding a group of the 1st Armoured Division. In May 1942 he was appointed to command the 1st Corps District and in October 1942 became commander of 1 Corps under General Eisenhower. He was tasked with preparing a subsidiary landing in the western Mediterranean, was then directed to plan the invasion of Sardinia, and then the invasion of Sicily.

heading.zh-Hant: 盟軍最高統帥參謀長（COSSAC）與諾曼第登陸規劃
heading.en: COSSAC and planning the Normandy invasion

body.zh-Hant: 1943年春，摩根成為最高盟軍統帥（候任）的參謀長（COSSAC），該參謀部於1943年4月組成。他奉命擬定牽制敵軍的佯動計畫（COCKADE）、德軍瓦解時重返歐陸的計畫（RANKIN），以及盡早於1944年對歐陸發動全面進攻的計畫（OVERLORD），也就是後來的諾曼第登陸。他在倫敦諾福克大樓設立參謀部，並由美方副手雷·巴克少將協助。
body.en: In spring 1943 Morgan became Chief of Staff to the Supreme Allied Commander (Designate), COSSAC, whose staff was organized in April 1943. He was directed to prepare a diversionary plan (COCKADE), a plan to return to the Continent in the event of German disintegration (RANKIN), and a plan for a full-scale assault on the Continent as early as possible in 1944 (OVERLORD), the later Normandy invasion. He set up his staff at Norfolk House in London with the aid of his U.S. deputy, Maj. Gen. Ray W. Barker.

body.zh-Hant: 最高司令部（SHAEF）成立後，艾森豪接受史密斯的建議，由前 COSSAC 主官出任副參謀長，摩根則請求留在最高司令部任職，而不接任英國軍的軍長職務。他在此職位上有時代行參謀長之職，並於1944至1945年擔任最高司令部副參謀長。
body.en: When SHAEF was formed, Eisenhower accepted Smith's recommendation that the former COSSAC head become deputy chief of staff; Morgan had asked to serve in some capacity in SHAEF instead of taking command of a British corps. In this post he acted from time to time as chief of staff, serving as Deputy Chief of Staff, SHAEF in 1944 and 1945.

people.name: Henry Rawlinson, 1st Baron Rawlinson

body.zh-Hant: 羅林森（1864–1925）畢業於伊頓公學與桑赫斯特皇家軍事學院。早年軍旅包括1886年的緬甸起事、1898年隨基奇納將軍的幕僚參與蘇丹的恩圖曼進軍，以及1899至1902年作為野戰指揮官參加布爾戰爭。
body.en: Rawlinson (1864-1925) was a graduate of Eton College and the Royal Military College, Sandhurst. His early service included the Burma uprising in 1886, the advance on Omdurman in the Sudan in 1898 as part of General Kitchener's staff, and field command in the Boer War from 1899 to 1902.

heading.zh-Hant: 第四集團軍與索姆河戰役

body.zh-Hant: 一戰爆發時，他獲任駐法國第4師師長；其後指揮第4軍，1916年1月晉升中將，接掌新成立的第四集團軍。他深度參與索姆河戰役，之後晉升上將。
body.en: When war broke out in 1914 he was appointed General Officer Commanding the 4th Division in France. After commanding IV Corps he was promoted Lieutenant General in January 1916 and took command of the new Fourth Army. After strong involvement in the Battle of the Somme he was promoted General.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年8月8日，羅林森的第四集團軍在亞眠發動大規模進攻，攻擊德軍春季攻勢造成的脆弱突出部；他動用兩千多門火炮、450輛坦克和1,900架飛機，支援13個師的攻擊。澳洲戰爭紀念館指出，他在亞眠戰役期間再度指揮第四集團軍，並大量依靠澳洲、加拿大與美國部隊。
body.en: On 8 August 1918 Rawlinson's Fourth Army launched a major attack at Amiens against the vulnerable salient created by the German offensive, using over 2,000 guns, 450 tanks and 1,900 aeroplanes to support 13 divisions. The Australian War Memorial notes that he again commanded the Fourth Army during the Battle of Amiens, relying heavily on Australian, Canadian and American troops.

body.zh-Hant: 普盧默（1857–1932）是英國陸軍元帥。他在第二次伊珀爾戰役期間指揮第5軍，並於1915年5月接掌第二軍。
body.en: Field Marshal Plumer (1857-1932) commanded V Corps at the Second Battle of Ypres and took command of the Second Army in May 1915.

commanded V Corps in at the Second Battle of Ypres
citations.evidenceNote: 原文寫 "in April 1916" 與 "May 1915" 自相矛盾，本段不採第二次伊珀爾戰役日期，僅採第二軍 1915 年 5 月

citations.quote: before taking command of the Second Army in May 1915.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年6月7日凌晨3時10分，十九枚大型地雷在維特謝特—梅西訥山脊的德軍戰壕下爆炸，由普盧默爵士指揮的英軍隨即向前猛攻。澳洲戰爭紀念館記載，這次進攻是普盧默第二軍長期準備、詳細規劃與紮實訓練的成果，地雷估計造成一萬名德軍傷亡。
body.en: At 3.10 am on 7 June 1917 nineteen powerful mines exploded under the German trenches along the Wytschaete–Messines ridge and the British troops, commanded by General Sir Herbert Plumer, surged forward. The Australian War Memorial records the offensive as the product of long preparation, detailed planning and sound training by Plumer's Second Army; the mines caused an estimated 10,000 German casualties.

body.zh-Hant: 澳洲戰爭紀念館記載，普盧默戰後出任英國萊茵軍團總司令，之後擔任馬爾他總督，1925年起任英國託管巴勒斯坦高級專員，1927年主持梅嫩門紀念碑的落成儀式。英國國會人物頁載明，他自1919年10月4日起為普盧默男爵、1929年6月24日起為子爵，1932年7月16日去世；1921年7月20日，他以普盧默男爵身分被引介入上議院。
body.en: The Australian War Memorial records that after the war Plumer served as Commander-in-Chief of the British Army of the Rhine, then as Governor of Malta, became High Commissioner of the British Mandate for Palestine in 1925, and conducted the inauguration of the Menin Gate Memorial in 1927. The UK Parliament record shows him as Baron Plumer from 4 October 1919 and Viscount from 24 June 1929 until his death on 16 July 1932; on 20 July 1921 he was introduced in the Lords as Baron Plumer.

heading.zh-Hant: 布爾戰爭與一戰高級指揮
heading.en: Boer War and senior commands in the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 史密斯-多里恩（1858–1930）在布爾戰爭期間是年輕軍官，其後在第一次世界大戰中擔任英國遠征軍的高級指揮官。澳洲戰爭紀念館藏有他1916年4月2日的信件，信中提及即將造訪錫利群島，而他的兄弟當時正是該群島的總督。
body.en: Smith-Dorrien (1858-1930) was a young officer during the Boer War and went on to hold senior commands within the British Expeditionary Force in the First World War. The Australian War Memorial holds his letter of 2 April 1916 mentioning an impending visit to the Scilly Islands, whose governor at the time was his brother.

citations.quote: Sir Smith-Dorrien (1858-1930) was a young officer during the Boer War
holding senior commands within the British Expeditionary Force
His letter dated 2 April 1916 mentions an impending visit to the Scilly Islands.
Thomas Algernon Smith-Dorrien-Smith was governor of the islands

heading.en: II Corps and the Battle of Le Cateau

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月，詹姆斯·格里森中將猝逝後，他被任命為英國遠征軍第2軍軍長。作戰初期，第1軍與第2軍在德軍重壓下被分隔，他組織起倉促的防禦，並於1914年8月26至27日打了勒卡托戰役。國家陸軍博物館稱此役是以寡擊眾的盟軍成功，使其餘英國遠征軍得以在其後一週不受德軍干擾地撤退。
body.en: In August 1914, after the sudden death of Lieutenant-General Sir James Grierson, he was made commander of II Corps of the British Expeditionary Force. Early in the campaign I Corps and II Corps were separated under heavy German pressure; he organised a hasty defence at Le Cateau, and the Battle of Le Cateau (26-27 August 1914) was, in the National Army Museum's words, an Allied success against superior numbers that let the rest of the BEF retreat without German interference for the next week.

body.zh-Hant: 政府藝術收藏的人物頁稱他為「將軍；1918至1923年任直布羅陀總督」。澳洲戰爭紀念館另記載，他與妻子奧利夫育有三子；長子格倫費爾在第二次世界大戰中陣亡，次子彼得死於1946年大衛王酒店爆炸案。
body.en: The Government Art Collection describes him as General and Governor of Gibraltar 1918-23. The Australian War Memorial records that he and his wife Olive had three sons: the eldest, Grenfell, was killed in the Second World War, and the second, Peter, died in the King David Hotel bombing in 1946.
